_comment: Smoothness / effort penalty weights of every PoOlympics task (read by poolympic/penalties.py into tasks/matt_env.py, the base of every body's tasks; mirrored by the Unity asset Assets/PoOlympic/Resources/RewardPenalties.asset, checked by RewardPenaltiesTests). Each weight is multiplied by the env step dt like every mjlab reward term. These are the values the shipped brains were trained with: changing one changes the task cfgs (tools/dump_task_cfgs.py --diff) and needs new task IDs and retraining; nothing shipped is retrained by editing this file. joint_vel_l2 is 0 for every shipped task, so it adds no term.
